description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences) for two different language models under three distinct training conditions. The horizontal axis displays the categories, which are two models labeled "GPT-4o" and "GPT-4o-mini", arranged from left to right without a specific overarching axis label. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)", using a linear scale that ranges from 0.00 to 1.00 with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.25. The chart features grouped bars, where each model category contains a cluster of three adjacent bars representing different training conditions, as indicated by a legend in the top left corner. The grey bars represent the "Control" condition, the light blue bars represent "Before Introspection Training", and the dark blue bars represent "After Introspection Training". Each bar includes a vertical error bar with caps. For the GPT-4o category, the Control bar is approximately 0.10, the Before Introspection Training bar is roughly 0.54, and the After Introspection Training bar is about 0.74. For the GPT-4o-mini category, the Control bar is the shortest in the chart, dipping slightly below the zero line to approximately -0.01, while the Before Introspection Training bar is near 0.51, and the After Introspection Training bar is the tallest at approximately 0.75. The bars are not sorted by height, but rather grouped by model and ordered consistently by training condition within each group, with no specific visual emphasis applied to any individual bar.
